    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AuthenticatingFailureCounter
    Interface for counting authentication failure attempts, used to enforce retry limits and trigger captcha requirements.
    AuthenticatingFailureRequestCounter
    Failure counter implementation that reads retry counts from request parameters rather than maintaining server-side state.
    AuthenticatingFailureSessionCounter
    Failure counter implementation that stores and increments retry counts in the HTTP session for server-side tracking.
    AuthenticationRequest
    Data transfer object representing a REST-mode login request with username, password, and optional captcha fields.
    CaptchaIncorrectException
    Exception thrown when the provided captcha value does not match the expected value stored in the session.
    CaptchaNotFoundException
    Exception thrown when a required captcha value is missing from the authentication request.
    CaptchaResolver
    Interface for captcha validation and storage implementations, supporting session-based or external captcha services.
    ContentType
    Constants for common HTTP content types and character encodings used throughout the pac4j extension framework.
    HttpHeaders
    Constants for standard HTTP header names used in HTTP communication within the pac4j extension framework.
    HttpUtils2
    Extended HTTP utility class providing methods for building URLs, opening HTTP connections, and managing session IDs.
    MethodNotSupportedException
     
    NoParameterCallbackUrlExtResolver
    Callback URL resolver that optionally overrides the computed URL with a fixed callback URL for external authentication flows.
    NullCaptchaResolver
    No-op captcha resolver that always returns true for validation.
    OverRetryRemindException
    Exception thrown when the number of failed login attempts has reached the configured retry limit, requiring captcha verification.
    Pac4jExtConstants
    Constants used throughout the pac4j extension framework, including parameter names for captcha, token, and signature authentication flows.
    Pac4jExternalAuthorizer
    Authorizer implementation for external authentication scenarios that delegates profile authorization checks.
    Pac4jInternalAuthorizer
    Authorizer implementation for internal authentication scenarios that delegates profile authorization checks.
    PathParameterCallbackUrlExtResolver
    Callback URL resolver that embeds the client name as a path parameter, with optional fixed callback URL override.
    QueryParameterCallbackUrlExtResolver
    Callback URL resolver that appends the client name and custom parameters as query parameters, with optional fixed callback URL override.
    SessionCaptchaResolver
    Session-based captcha resolver that stores and validates captcha values using HTTP session attributes.
    Signature
    Abstract base class representing a cryptographic signature, providing access to the raw response and parameter extraction.
    SignatureAuthenticator<C,P,T>
    Authenticator for signature-based credentials.
    SignatureClient<C,P,T>
    Direct client for signature-based authentication.
    SignatureCredentials
    Credentials implementation that holds a payload and its corresponding signature for signature-based authentication.
    SignatureParameterExtractor
    Credentials extractor that retrieves signature and payload values from request parameters for signature-based authentication.
    SignatureProfile
    User profile implementation for signature-based authentication, returned by the SignatureClient.
    SignatureProfileCreator
    Signature profile creator.
    SignatureProfileDefinition<P,T>
    Abstract profile definition for signature-based authentication, providing methods to extract user profiles from signed payloads.
    SignatureProfileDefinitionAware<P,T>
    For classes that can set the profile definition.
    Token
    Represents an abstract token (either request or access token)
    TokenAuthenticator<P,T>
    Authenticator for token-based credentials.
    TokenClient<P,T>
    Direct client for token-based authentication.
    TokenParameterExtractor
    Credentials extractor that retrieves token values from request parameters or HTTP headers for token-based authentication.
    TokenProfile
    User profile implementation for token-based authentication, returned by the TokenClient.
    TokenProfileCreator
    Token profile creator.
    TokenProfileDefinition<P,T>
    Abstract profile definition for token-based authentication, providing methods to retrieve user profiles from token-authenticated API calls.
    TokenProfileDefinitionAware<P,T>
    For classes that can set the profile definition.
    UserDetails
    Interface representing authenticated user details including username, password, roles, permissions, and account status flags.
    UserDetailsAuthorizationGenerator<U>
    Authorization generator that loads user details (roles and permissions) from a UserDetailsService and adds them to the user profile.
    UserDetailsService<U>
    Interface for loading user details by username, similar to Spring Security's UserDetailsService pattern.
    UsernameNotFoundException
    Exception thrown when the specified username cannot be found during the authentication process.
    UsernamePasswordCaptchaAuthenticator
    Authenticator that validates username/password credentials with optional captcha verification and retry limit enforcement.
    UsernamePasswordCaptchaCredentials
    Credentials implementation that extends username/password authentication with an optional captcha field for bot protection.
    UsernamePasswordCaptchaCredentialsExtractor
    Credentials extractor that retrieves username, password, and captcha values from form parameters or JSON request bodies.
    UsernamePasswordCaptchaFormClient
    Indirect client for form-based login with username, password, and captcha support.
    WebUtils
    Utility class providing helper methods for HTTP request inspection including AJAX detection, content type checking, and URL building.
